remarks:
Located in desirable Bemus Point on beautiful Chautauqua Lake, this charming year-round lakefront cottage offers the perfect blend of comfort, character, and waterfront living. Situated on two lots with 35 feet of lake frontage, this property features 2 bedrooms, 1 full bath, and beautiful outdoor spaces designed to enjoy lake life to the fullest.
Inside, you’ll find an inviting open floor plan where the kitchen flows seamlessly into the living room, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere for everyday living or entertaining guests. The home features low-maintenance vinyl siding, laminate flooring, and some wall-to-wall carpeting for added comfort.
Step outside to a spacious deck and stone patio overlooking the water—ideal for morning coffee, summer gatherings, or simply taking in the peaceful lake views.
A major bonus is the detached heated garage featuring radiant heat in the concrete floors, making it a comfortable and versatile space for multiple uses such as vehicle storage, a workshop, hobby area, fitness space, or additional entertaining.
Additional utilities include private water and public sewer. Whether you’re looking for a full-time residence, weekend getaway, or investment opportunity, this waterfront property offers a rare chance to own a piece of Chautauqua Lake living.
